title: compile_error! on non-Unix for TLS key generation: correct enforcement of 0o600 requirement
description: tls.rs lines 133-139: compile_error! under #[cfg(not(unix))] ensures the binary cannot build on a platform where OpenOptions::mode() (0o600) is unavailable. The alternative — a runtime check — would silently produce a key file with wrong permissions on non-Unix, which is a security regression. The compile-time error is the correct enforcement point. A contributor porting to Windows might remove this error; they should know they must first implement OS-appropriate owner-only permissions before removing the guard.
